name: White-throated Sparrow
facts: Call pattern: a thin, wavering whistle often written "Oh-sweet-Canada-Canada-Canada."
Habitat: forest edges and thickets, scratching through leaf litter. Comes in white-striped and tan-striped forms that almost always pair with the opposite type.
Migration: breeds in northern forests and passes through the Great Lakes in big waves each spring and fall.
